title: Strict JSON against a schema
why: Tool calling and structured output are the foundation of any agent system. Checked mechanically. Note that the schema requires an integer year while the text gives none — see task 10, which was written once this task's blind spot became visible.
prompt:
Return ONLY a JSON object, with no markdown code fence and no text before or after it, with exactly these keys:
  title     (string)
  year      (integer)
  authors   (array of string)
  uncertain (array of string: the keys whose value you could NOT determine with certainty from the text)

Text:
"The work on polarisation by non-spherical dust particles was presented by Halvorsen and colleagues; an earlier version had already circulated as a preprint."
